description: Source code implementing time conversion functions between POSIX time and struct tm, including validation and range checks, inspired by Howard Hinnant's date algorithms.

methods.name: is_valid_date
methods.description: Checks if a given year/month/day combination is valid within the range 0000-9999.

methods.name: is_valid_time
methods.description: Validates hours, minutes, and seconds (excluding leap seconds).

methods.name: is_valid_epoch_time
methods.description: Checks if a given int64_t time is within the supported range (from year 0000 to 9999).

methods.name: posix_time_from_utc
methods.description: Converts a date/time in UTC to POSIX time_t, based on Howard Hinnant's algorithm.

methods.name: utc_from_posix_time
methods.description: Converts POSIX time_t to a UTC date/time components, using Howard Hinnant's algorithm.
